directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 60 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Main-unit weight is is 3300 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirit_level.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。理论输送量是40 m³/h，最大出口压力是35 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirit_level。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirit_level. Subject: DetalleNivelDeBurbuja. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 60 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Theoretical Output is 40 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 35 MPa. Main-unit weight is is 3300 kg. Subject: Excavator shovel Kobelco config. Max. Outlet Pressure is 35 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 112.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirit_level。画面主体：DetalleNivelDeBurbuja。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。外形尺寸是6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 3300 kg. The frame “Backhoe” shows Excavator shovel Kobelco config and is not a site measurement of this model. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Hopper capacity is 0.7 m³. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 理论输送量是40 m³/h，最大出口压力是35 MPa。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。细石输送（水平/垂直） 200 m / 600 m。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. The shown output stays 40 m³/h. Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m.
body.zh: 画面「Backhoe」的主体是挖掘机 shovel Kobelco config，不是这个型号的工地实测。主体：挖掘机 shovel Kobelco config。液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 112。

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirit_level.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirit_level画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 40 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spirit_level.
